This is a single piece of tuna nigiri on a large plate. A piece like this usually weighs about 25-30 g in total: roughly 15 g of fish and 15 g of rice.

The rice contributes about 15-20 g × 1.3 kcal/g, or about 25 kcal. The tuna contributes about 12 g × 1.3 kcal/g, or about 15-20 kcal. That puts the total at roughly 45 kcal.

The plate looks about 26 cm across and the piece is about 5 cm long, which fits a standard nigiri size.
